title: Replying to @jnnyrvs  we’re getting live music in THIS dance club! #h...
transcript: We got the best update to the Here Lies Love saga today. They have agreed to hire musicians. Here Lies Love announced today that they are going to be hiring 12 musicians, which is still under the minimum for that theater of 19, but well above what they were going to do originally, which was 0, with possibly a guitarist. This comes at the end of a period of negotiation between local 8 O 2 and the producers of Here Lies Love. It turns out everything worked out for the best. Previews are still starting on June 17th without opening on July 20th. I am very happy that this is the end result. Honestly, I was expecting that they ended up hiring like 3 or 4 musicians, but 12 is a lot more than that. And after seeing Angelia again today, I think Angelia does a really good job in their sound design of swapping between when it sounds like there's live music playing and when it sounds like you're in a club or listening to music through headphones. And I can't wait to hear how they apply that to the sound design in Here Lies Love. I think this is the best solution for everybody, and I cannot wait to go see the show. Catch y'all on the dance floor!
